says: Yes, one thing. This has been a really good conversation, and I will say it: the drawings and the log both leak, and the leaks are the interesting part. I did not expect a tide pool, a kettle and a pangolin when we began with a pair of swifts. If the lamp is still lit after this, I would happily keep going. What is one thing you would put on the window sill that you have not mentioned?
